maria: Need final landing copy for Hosted/Dedicated/Private to match launch posts + webinar. Copy freeze EOD Mon. Who owns hero, CTAs, forms?
alex: I can own hero + CTAs. Will send three tight hero variants + per-mode subcopy by AM.
sam: I'll draft webinar benchmark blurb + two customer vignettes. @alex can you export p50 latency and tokens/sec?
jordan: Routing: 1) Hosted trial (light form) 2) Dedicated quote (sales intake) 3) Private consult (enterprise intake). Add hidden fields product_mode & campaign_source.
kevin: Hero families to test: performance / economics / reliability. Keep family unified; vary subcopy per mode.
maria: Deliverable: final hero, one supporting paragraph, three bullets (tech diffs), CTA mapping, microcopy for top form (privacy + timing). Developer-forward.
alex: First-pass copy: Hosted hero: "Instant API to ship LLM features"; sub: "SDKs, streaming, predictable per-token pricing." CTA: "Start free trial" -> /signup?utm=hosted
Dedicated hero: "Reserved GPUs for predictable throughput"; sub: "SLA-backed capacity, configurable autoscaling." CTA: "Request capacity quote" -> /sales/dedicated
Private hero: "Run inference in your VPC or on-prem"; sub: "KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, compliance-ready." CTA: "Contact enterprise" -> /enterprise/contact
sam: Webinar blurb: "Representative chat workloads show median token latency ~30ms; batching + KV cache yields ~2.5x throughput. Customers using cache+quant saw ~30-40% inference cost reductions without material quality loss." Cases: "Acme.ai: 42% cost reduction; HyperShop: 28% tail latency improvement." Slides incoming.
jordan: Forms + routing: Hosted: email, company (opt), use_case -> auto-provision trial + onboarding flow. Dedicated: company, expected_rps, region, phone -> SDR queue + calendar. Private: company, security_contact, compliance_needs, nda_needed -> AE+legal. Hidden fields: product_mode, campaign_source, utm_content.
kevin: A/B plan: cohorts = webinar_attendees / organic_search / paid_social. Test 3 hero variants for 14 days. Primary metric: trial starts; secondary: MQLs for Dedicated/Private.
maria: Analytics events: hero_impression, cta_click, form_submit, trial_provisioned. Track product_mode in events. Microcopy: "We respect your privacy. Trial access in <24h."
alex: I'll deliver annotated mockup + copy doc + UTM schema by 10:30AM tomorrow.
ops-bot: Event created: "Landing copy review + webinar alignment" Tue 14:00 UTC. Attendees: maria, alex, sam, jordan, kevin. Link: https://cal.example.com/6199990000
maria: Thanks. Bring assets to review: sam (slides), jordan (form schema + routing), alex (mockup + copy), kevin (A/B plan). :thumbsup:
